name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US land-route task force; Qatar mediates
summary: US launches Task Force Iron Gate on 7 Nov to curb Iran's land routes; US strike on Qeshm on 6 Nov; mediation continues
state: US Central Command announced Task Force Iron Gate on 7 Nov to disrupt land and Caspian routes into Iran, adding to its naval blockade; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said the effort will fail (Al Jazeera; AFP via Malay Mail). President Trump confirmed US strikes on an Iranian air-defence site on Qeshm late on 6 Nov (Al Jazeera). Qatar and other mediators are working to prevent a return to full-scale fighting, and Iran says it will not make concessions (Khaleej Times).
for_you: People with links to the Gulf can check FCDO travel advice. Energy and shipping costs remain exposed while the conflict and blockade continue.
rubric_hit: Active US–Iran strikes (Qeshm, 6 Nov) and attacks on Gulf shipping; Hormuz restricted

sources.title: Al Jazeera — US launches task force to disrupt Iran's land-based supply routes
Malay Mail (AFP) — US launches task force to disrupt land transit routes into Iran
Khaleej Times — US to set up task force to prevent Iran from ground transit of weapons

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
